_description: Multi-step ETL output example — demonstrates single-cell consolidation: 4 intermediate steps but exactly 5 output rows (one per target column). All step detail is in business_logic cells, never step-per-row.

rows.business_logic:
Driver Table: work_db.risk_merged (rm)
Value: rm.account_id
---
Transformation Lineage:
Step 1 (Normal risk score): FROM s_acctdb.account_base (ab)
  INNER JOIN r_refdb.risk_params (rp) ON ab.scorecard_id = rp.scorecard_id
  [Filter ab.behaviour_score > 31, ab.status_code NOT IN ('A','B','X')]
  Columns: account_id = ab.account_id [New]
  Columns: risk_score = 1/(1+EXP((rp.score_weight * ab.behaviour_score) + (rp.balance_weight * CASE WHEN ab.credit_limit = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(ab.balance AS DECIMAL(18,10)) / CAST(ab.credit_limit AS DECIMAL(18,10)) END) + rp.intercept)) [New]
  Grain: account_id
  → risk_normal

Step 2 (Fallback risk score): FROM s_acctdb.account_base (ab)
  INNER JOIN r_refdb.risk_params_fallback (rpf) ON ab.delinquency_code = rpf.delinquency_code
  [Filter ab.behaviour_score <= 31, ab.status_code NOT IN ('A','B','X')]
  Columns: account_id = ab.account_id [New]
  Columns: risk_score = rpf.default_score [New]
  Grain: account_id
  → risk_fallback

Step 3 (Merge + derive band): FROM s_acctdb.account_base (drv)
  LEFT JOIN work_db.risk_normal (rn) ON drv.account_id = rn.account_id
  LEFT JOIN work_db.risk_fallback (rf) ON drv.account_id = rf.account_id
  Columns: risk_score = CASE WHEN COALESCE(rf.risk_score, rn.risk_score) >= 0.9999995 THEN 0.999999 ELSE COALESCE(rf.risk_score, rn.risk_score) END [New]
  Columns: risk_band = CASE WHEN COALESCE(rf.risk_score, rn.risk_score) < 0.003 THEN '1' WHEN < 0.012 THEN '2' WHEN < 0.050 THEN '3' WHEN < 0.100 THEN '4' WHEN < 1 THEN '5' ELSE NULL END [New]
  Columns: exposure_value = CASE WHEN drv.credit_limit > drv.highest_balance THEN drv.credit_limit ELSE drv.highest_balance END [New]
  Grain: account_id
  → risk_merged

Step 4 (Final insert): FROM work_db.risk_merged (rm)
  Columns: account_id = rm.account_id [Pass-through]
  Columns: risk_score = rm.risk_score [Pass-through]
  Columns: risk_band = rm.risk_band [Pass-through]
  Columns: exposure_value = rm.exposure_value [Pass-through]
  Columns: load_date = CURRENT_DATE [New]
  → t_riskdb.risk_metrics
---
Effective Source Filters:
  s_acctdb.account_base: behaviour_score > 31 (Step 1), behaviour_score <= 31 (Step 2), status_code NOT IN ('A','B','X') (Steps 1,2)
